name: BTQ Quantum-Protected Testnet
summary: BTQ Technologies launched the first operational Bitcoin testnet implementing BIP-360 (P2MR). Features 5 Dilithium post-quantum signature opcodes, SegWit v2 (bc1z) addresses, 64 MiB blocks, restored SegWit discount, and end-to-end CLI wallet tools. 50+ miners, 100K+ blocks mined. Mainnet targeted for Q2 2026.
summaryZh: BTQ Technologies 发布了首个实现 BIP-360（P2MR）的比特币测试网。包含 5 个 Dilithium 后量子签名操作码、SegWit v2（bc1z）地址、64 MiB 区块、恢复 SegWit 折扣和端到端 CLI 钱包工具。已有 50+ 矿工加入，挖出 100,000+ 区块。主网目标 2026 Q2 启动。
